name: The 13th Grave
source:
A strained group of once close lifelong friends return to their hometown to confront their dark history and unanswered mistakes…

Put yourself in the shoes of Hunter Quickwing as he returns to his hometown of Everglade to collect his family will with his friends: Juni the hypnotist cobra, Lucas the androgynous axolotyl, and Bull the lion.  They used to be the Everglade Underdogs, but they've grown apart over the years...

Uncover the dark past of the Everglade Underdogs, confront the guilt, endure the pain your mistakes have brought, and become a better man once the sun rises... If you can survive the night.

[From [url=https://floofy-loofy.itch.io/the-13th-grave]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一群关系紧张的终生好友回到家乡，面对他们的黑暗历史和未解决的错误……

扮演猎人快翼的角色，与他的朋友们一起返回故乡大沼泽地收集家人遗嘱：催眠师眼镜蛇朱尼、雌雄同体的美西螈卢卡斯和狮子布尔。他们曾经是大沼泽地的失败者，但这些年来他们已经疏远了……

揭开大沼泽地失败者的黑暗过去，面对罪恶感，忍受错误带来的痛苦，并在太阳升起时成为一个更好的人……如果你能熬过这个夜晚。

[来自[url=https://floofy-loofy.itch.io/the-13th-grave]Itch.io[/url]]
